validity.researcher_notes: Identification: this row is the Northern Lights 2025 Expansion, FERC Docket CP24-60 (section 7 application filed by Northern Natural Gas Feb 16, 2024) -- four branch-line extensions in MN/WI (2.43 mi 30-in Elk River 3rd loop; 1.91 mi 30-in Farmington-Hugo C-line; 3.00 mi 36-in Lake Mills-Albert Lea E-line; 1.28 mi 8-in Tomah branch loop) plus minor compressor-station modifications at La Crescent. This is confirmed DISTINCT from the other five same-named roster rows: P2578 (NL 2019/Rochester-era), P2603 (Rochester), P2734 (NL 2017, docket CP16-472, 5 mi, 8/12-in, NM=New Mexico county code per EIA but the project is actually sited per the docket -- not this row's scope, not researched here), P3942 (NL 2021, docket PF20-1/CP20-503), P3943 (NL 2023, docket CP22-138). Each has its own docket and its own EIA project row; none overlaps P7772's CP24-60 facilities. Existence and classification confirmed independently via the operator's own current project page (northernnaturalgas.com/expansion-projects/northern-lights/, refreshed 2026-09-15, which documents the FERC filing, docket number, construction-start notices and in-service notices for all four components through Nov 2025 / quarterly report March 2026) and the EIA dated workbook series (project first appears Applied in the Apr2024 release, Completed by the Aug2026 release). PipelineType='transmission' is supported by inference rather than a literal quote: EIA codes Authority=FERC / Pipeline Type=Interstate, and the operator's page describes the facilities as extensions of Northern's existing interstate transportation system -- consistent with transmission, not gathering or distribution. Old ref on most cells was https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php#pipelines, a navigation page that does not name this pipeline (confirmed by the builder's own pre-check, name_found=false) -- replaced throughout with the dated EIA release + the operator's own project page.
